entries.title: Ephesians 5:1
segments: ¶Be ye therefore imitators of God, as beloved children,

entries.title: Ephesians 5:2
segments: and walk in love, even as the Christ loved us, and delivered himself up for us, an offering and sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling savour.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:3
segments: ¶But fornication and all uncleanness or unbridled lust, let it not be even named among you, as it becomes saints;

entries.title: Ephesians 5:4
segments: and filthiness and foolish talking, or jesting, which are not convenient; but rather thanksgiving.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:5
segments: For this ye are [well] informed of, knowing that no fornicator, or unclean person, or person of unbridled lust, who is an idolater, has inheritance in the kingdom of the Christ and God.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:6
segments: Let no one deceive you with vain words, for on account of these things the wrath of God comes upon the sons of disobedience.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:7
segments: Be not ye therefore fellow-partakers with them;

entries.title: Ephesians 5:8
segments: for ye were once darkness, but now light in [the] Lord; walk as children of light,

entries.title: Ephesians 5:9
segments: (for the fruit of the light [is] in all goodness and righteousness and truth,)

entries.title: Ephesians 5:10
segments: proving what is agreeable to the Lord;

entries.title: Ephesians 5:11
segments: and do not have fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather also reprove [them],

entries.title: Ephesians 5:12
segments: for the things that are done by them in secret it is shameful even to say.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:13
segments: But all things having their true character exposed by the light are made manifest; for that which makes everything manifest is light.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:14
segments: Wherefore he says, Wake up, [thou] that sleepest, and arise up from among the dead, and the Christ shall shine upon thee.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:15
segments: See therefore how ye walk carefully, not as unwise but as wise,

entries.title: Ephesians 5:16
segments: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:17
segments: For this reason be not foolish, but understanding what [is] the will of the Lord.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:18
segments: And be not drunk with wine, in which is debauchery; but be filled with the Spirit,

entries.title: Ephesians 5:19
segments: speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and chanting with your heart to the Lord;

entries.title: Ephesians 5:20
segments: giving thanks at all times for all things to him [who is] God and [the] Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ,

entries.title: Ephesians 5:21
segments: ¶submitting yourselves to one another in [the] fear of Christ.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:22
segments: Wives, [submit yourselves] to your own husbands, as to the Lord,

entries.title: Ephesians 5:23
segments: for a husband is head of the wife, as also the Christ [is] head of the assembly. *He* [is] Saviour of the body.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:24
segments: But even as the assembly is subjected to the Christ, so also wives to their own husbands in everything.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:25
segments: Husbands, love your own wives, even as the Christ also loved the assembly, and has delivered himself up for it,

entries.title: Ephesians 5:26
segments: in order that he might sanctify it, purifying [it] by the washing of water by [the] word,

entries.title: Ephesians 5:27
segments: that *he* might present the assembly to himself glorious, having no spot, or wrinkle, or any of such things; but that it might be holy and blameless.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:28
segments: So ought men also to love their own wives as their own bodies: he that loves his own wife loves himself.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:29
segments: For no one has ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as also the Christ the assembly:

entries.title: Ephesians 5:30
segments: for we are members of his body; [we are of his flesh, and of his bones.]

entries.title: Ephesians 5:31
segments: Because of this a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be united to his wife, and the two shall be one flesh.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:32
segments: This mystery is great, but *I* speak as to Christ, and as to the assembly.

entries.title: Ephesians 5:33
segments: But *ye* also, every one of you, let each so love his own wife as himself; but as to the wife [I speak] that she may fear the husband.
